title: From a UI workflow to API format, and setting values by node id

questions.q: What is the safest way to get an API-format graph?
options: File, Export Workflow (API) in the editor
questions.answer: File, Export Workflow (API) in the editor
questions.why: The front end knows about widgets, bypass and subgraphs. A converter has to reinvent all that.

questions.q: Why is the second value of a KSampler's widgets_values not steps?
options: It is the seed's control setting, used only by the editor
questions.answer: It is the seed's control setting, used only by the editor
questions.why: The list runs seed, control, steps, and so on. The control value is not sent to the server.

questions.q: Your script sets inputs["sed"] by mistake. What does the real server do?
options: It accepts the graph, ignores the name, and the seed stays as it was
questions.answer: It accepts the graph, ignores the name, and the seed stays as it was
questions.why: A real run with unknown input names passed validation and ran.

questions.q: How does a script tell a wire from a value in an input?
options: A wire is a two-item list
Wires are in a separate dict
questions.answer: A wire is a two-item list
questions.why: That's why arrays get wrapped in __value__.

questions.q: Why search by class_type and check for exactly one match?
options: Titles can repeat and be edited, and two prompt nodes share a class
IDs are random on each run
questions.answer: Titles can repeat and be edited, and two prompt nodes share a class
questions.why: The lab's search raises an error when it finds two.
